method: Hand-crafted features: 512-bin RGB colour histogram + HOG (9 orient., 8x8 cells)
explanation: Val accuracy 0.813 / macro precision 0.848 with classical features only - already above the team's from-scratch CNN on Kaggle (0.788). Train accuracy 1.0 shows the SVM memorises the training set (overfitting), so the 2276-dim hand-crafted representation is the bottleneck. Colour palette + edge orientation carry a lot of vendor style, but not enough for fine details (shading, outlines).
preprocessing: Alpha-composited on white background, resized to 64x64 (bicubic)
preprocessing_why: White compositing removes the hidden-colour shortcut and gives every vendor the same canvas; 64 px keeps HOG dimensionality manageable for an SVM.
name: Erdem SANVER
